content.question: Match each pretrained model with its architecture and pretraining objective.

answer.BERT: Encoder-only, pretrained with masked language modeling (and next sentence prediction)
answer.GPT: Decoder-only, pretrained with causal next-token prediction
answer.T5: Encoder-decoder, pretrained with span corruption and used in a text-to-text framework
answer.BART: Encoder-decoder, pretrained by denoising corrupted text
